description: msw 3 from `msw/node` (T11.11) with the server made in a `setupFilesAfterEnv` module, the common project shape: `listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' })` in `beforeAll`, `resetHandlers` in `afterEach`, `close` in `afterAll`. Two test files on one worker, in the node environment, each fetch a handled URL and an unhandled one (msw 3 warns and passes it through; `api.example.invalid` never resolves, so the real fetch rejects). msw's interceptors add `globalThis.__MSW_INTERNAL_CONNECTION_CONTEXT` as they load and use it to tell msw's own passthrough connection from the client's: Jest evaluates msw again in every file against a fresh global. msw 3 ships ES modules only: the files `import` it under `jestEsm`, and Node runs with `--experimental-vm-modules`, which Jest 30.5.2 needs for its native `require(esm)`. No network. Read by `provino`'s `ecosystem-per-file.test.ts`.
